page_note: 该页为Activate Consulting关于美国游戏玩家分群的一张分组柱状图，展示Super/Avid/Casual三类玩家使用Mobile、Console、PC三种平台的比例，所有数值直接标注在柱顶，无数值轴。

heading.title: SHARE OF GAMERS¹ USING EACH PLATFORM FOR GAMING IN THE LAST 12 MONTHS
heading.subtitle: U.S., 2025

figures.source_line: Sources: Activate analysis, Activate 2025 Consumer Technology & Media Research Study (n = 4,026)

components.evidence: three bars side by side in each of SUPER GAMERS², AVID GAMERS³, CASUAL GAMERS⁴ slots
only a black baseline under the bars; no ticks or numbers on any vertical axis
MOBILE / CONSOLE / PC icon-and-name column at the left edge, level with the bars
pictograms of phone, gamepad and desktop precede MOBILE, CONSOLE, PC in the side legend
"SHARE OF GAMERS¹", "SUPER GAMERS²", "AVID GAMERS³", "CASUAL GAMERS⁴" carry superscript digits
banner ends "% GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT"; bars themselves carry no axis unit
numbered notes 1.-4. plus "Sources: Activate analysis, Activate 2025 Consumer Technology & Media Research Study (n = 4,026)"
green hand-drawn ovals circling Super Gamers' three bars, the 89% and the 87% bars
plot area sits on a pale blue hexagon-patterned tint rather than white

new_components.name: heading_in_filled_banner
new_components.evidence: heading set in white type on a solid blue full-width band above the plot
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题与单位在色带中，解析器可能把它当作页面横幅而非图表标题，导致数值失去上下文键。

new_components.name: mixed_weight_heading_line
new_components.evidence: banner is bold up to "LAST 12 MONTHS," then lighter "U.S., 2025, % GAMERS¹ BY SEGMENT"
new_components.why_it_matters: 、隷区分只靠字重。单/单位靠字重区分。/在能相同一行。副单/单位。区仴单位同在一行，需按字重切分标题、副标题与单位。

new_components.name: handdrawn_highlight_oval
new_components.evidence: three green marker-style ellipses drawn over bar tops and their value labels
new_components.why_it_matters: 手绘椭圆覆盖数值标签，可能遮挡或干扰OCR识别93%与89%等数字。

new_components.name: series_legend_as_stacked_rows
new_components.evidence: MOBILE, CONSOLE, PC listed as three stacked rows separated by horizontal rules at left
new_components.why_it_matters: 该竖排图例暗示柱内从左到右的系列顺序，读值时必须靠位置而非颜色标注来定系列。

spot_checks.mark: the SUPER GAMERS² MOBILE bar (leftmost, dark navy)
the SUPER GAMERS² CONSOLE bar (middle, mid-blue)
the SUPER GAMERS² PC bar (right, teal)
the AVID GAMERS³ MOBILE bar (dark navy)
the CASUAL GAMERS⁴ MOBILE bar (dark navy)

difficulty_notes: 九个数值全部印在柱顶，读数不成问题（步骤2无风险，也没有刻度轴可参照）；真正的障碍是寻址：每个值都需要“分群×平台”两个键，而平台名只出现在左侧竖排图例（MOBILE/CONSOLE/PC）里，柱子本身无标签，89%在SUPER GAMERS²-PC与AVID GAMERS³-MOBILE两处重复出现，若表格丢掉平台维度或列顺序，89%就无法唯一定位。此外三个分群标签都带上标数字（SUPER GAMERS²），逐字匹配容易失配。

suggestions.what_to_add: legend_beside_plot 与 icon_category_axis 组合：系列名以带图标的竖排列于绘图区左侧
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式条件行中新增 legend_position=beside_left 且 legend_item_icon=true
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 图例位于侧栏（含图标）vs 常规下方图例时，系列键被正确写入表头列名的比例

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 heading_in_filled_banner（标题+单位置于满宽实色色带内）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录字段：新增 heading_style=banner 及 heading placement=above 的渲染分支
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 色带式标题 vs 普通文本标题时，图题/单位被导出为粗体或标题行的比例

suggestions.what_to_add: footnote_marker：类别名与标题内嵌上标数字（SUPER GAMERS²）
suggestions.where_to_change: 类别名与标题字段允许附带上标标记，并在注释区生成对应编号注释
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 类别名带上标 vs 不带上标时，寻址键逐字匹配成功率

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 handdrawn_highlight_oval（手绘绿色椭圆圈注覆盖柱顶与数值标签）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标注层样式：新增 highlight_shape=hand_drawn_ellipse，可覆盖多个柱及其数值标签
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 数值标签被圈注图形叠压 vs 未叠压时，标签数字被正确读出的比例

suggestions.what_to_add: no_value_axis 与 value_label_outside 同时出现（仅基线，无刻度）
suggestions.where_to_change: 轴条件行：value_axis=none 且 value_label=outside 的组合
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 无数值轴仅靠外置标签 vs 有刻度轴时，数值召回率对比
